article_context: Body image for the section on physical activity before pregnancy; it supports starting with manageable, moderate exercise to improve wellbeing without overexertion.
image_reading: A woman performs a floor sit-up in a bright living room while a man kneels nearby, encouraging her with raised hands.
The pair and the exercise setup make the scene read as calm, at-home shared fitness rather than intense training.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The woman performs one controlled sit-up at a steady moderate pace while the man remains beside her in quiet encouragement; by the final frame she is upright with her balance settled, and both stay calmly focused.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the woman smoothly rises through one measured sit-up while the man holds his encouraging pose beside her. Keep the camera fixed and the pace moderate; her upright, stable seated position arrives in the final moments, with the supportive, calm training mood unchanged.

models.positive_prompt: The woman steadily completes a controlled sit-up as her partner stays close with calm encouragement. Fixed camera; end with her upright and balanced, both still focused on gentle exercise.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the pair. The woman rises through one smooth, moderate sit-up while the man quietly encourages her; in the last frame she is upright and steady, with their calm shared focus intact.
